description.value: Green Olive Market & Café is a café and market in Squamish, BC offering both indoor and outdoor seating. The combination of market and café format suggests a spot where cyclists passing through Squamish could stop for food and provisions. Its outdoor seating makes it a potential rest stop on rides in the Sea-to-Sky corridor.

address.value: 38161 Cleveland Ave, Squamish, BC V8B 0A6, Canada
